from contextlib import ExitStack, redirect_stdout, redirect_stderr
import hashlib, json, platform, subprocess, sys, time, unittest, warnings
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from verify_offline import ExecutionResult, case_ids, offline_network, python_result, source_snapshot, timestamp
stage = sys.argv[1]
modules = ['test_h1_paper_conflicts'] if stage == 'before' else ['test_h1_paper_conflicts', 'test_phase5a_paper', 'test_phase5b_forward', 'test_phase5c_recovery', 'test_astra_paper_triggers', 'test_astra_vwap_execution', 'test_track_a_order_block_execution', 'test_track_a_supertrend_execution', 'test_phase6_paper_lifecycle', 'test_phase6_risk_recovery', 'test_paper_sessions', 'test_astra_rank_history', 'test_market_data_contract']
prefix = Path('docs/evidence') / ('h1_paper_conflicts_' + stage + '_20261102_02')
log = prefix.with_suffix('.txt')
receipt = prefix.with_suffix('.json')
if receipt.exists() or log.exists():
    raise SystemExit('Evidence stage already exists')
started, before, unraisable = timestamp(), source_snapshot(), []
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
clock = time.monotonic()
with log.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream, redirect_stdout(stream), redirect_stderr(stream), ExitStack() as guards:
    offline_network(guards)
    guards.enter_context(patch('sys.unraisablehook', side_effect=lambda event: unraisable.append(type(event.exc_value).__name__)))
    warnings.simplefilter('error', ResourceWarning)
    import test_bot
    suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(modules)
    expected = list(case_ids(suite))
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=2, resultclass=ExecutionResult).run(suite)
    measured = python_result(result, expected)
after = source_snapshot()
data = dict(kind='TARGETED_H1_OFFLINE_VERIFICATION', stage=stage, status=measured['status'], command=sys.orig_argv, cwd=str(Path.cwd()), source_revision=head, source_before=before, source_after=after, source_unchanged=before == after, modules=modules, started_at=started, completed_at=timestamp(), duration_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-clock,3), python_version=sys.version.split()[0], platform=platform.platform(), external_network='BLOCKED', expected_red=stage == 'before', python=measured, unraisable_errors=unraisable, log=log.as_posix(), log_sha256=hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
receipt.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(dict(stage=stage, status=data['status'], executed=measured['executed'], passed=measured['passed'], failures=measured['failures'], errors=measured['errors'], skipped=measured['skipped'], duration_seconds=data['duration_seconds'], source_unchanged=data['source_unchanged'], unraisable_errors=unraisable, receipt=receipt.as_posix())))
raise SystemExit(measured['exit_code'] if before == after and not unraisable else 1)
